name: Estival-Obelisk

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by a nearby asteroid belt near the terminator.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
The colonists of the buried megastructure kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
Whoever controls iron controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
